ru: Торги идут. B — весло, ЛКМ — ставка

en: YOU WON THE LOT FOR $%d. HAUL IT.
Lot is yours. Door's open — carry it out.
Caretaker saw you. Next time — blacklist.

ru: Ты в ЧС площадки. Менты уже едут.
Хозяин уехал в Тайланд, десять лет назад. Говорят, там что-то тикает. Или это холодильник.
en: Owner left for Thailand ten years ago. They say something ticks in there. Or it's a fridge.

ru: ОПИСЬ (частично сгорела): ...ваза, коробки х3, ...ащик с..., ...чего ценного нет, честно.
en: INVENTORY (partly burnt): ...vase, boxes x3, ...rawer with..., ...nothing valuable, honestly.

ru: Лот %s! Стартуем с $%d. Смотрим, не трогаем.
en: Lot %s! Starting at $%d. Look, don't touch.
Bidding is open! Who's got more?
Sold to the trailer! Congrats. I guess.

column5: police? Psycho with a gun here.

en: Empty pot?! Lot goes to the next one.

column4: Do you even know what's in there?

en: Not letting it go that easy!

column4: Watch them haul it away. Beautiful.

en: Bring a fatter wallet next time.

ru: Кто видит вазу? Кто видит котёл?!
en: Who sees a vase? Who sees the pot?!
This isn't a casino, it's an AUCTION!
A fight?! The pot is shocked!
Stop it! Tape the wounds later!
Shoving goes to the station! Not here!
Not your lot right now. Back off.

ru: Торги живые. Не лезь в кадр.
en: Auction's live. Stay out of frame.
Pot said no. Lot moves on.

ru: ВОН! И котёл ваш тоже вон!
en: OUT! And take your pot with you!
Never set foot on this yard again!
IT'S BURNING! Lot to ash! Out!
Fire! The pot doesn't put it out!
UNIT ON FIRE! Vase is toast!
Once! Is the hamster in the pot?
This door is decoration for you.
Silence. Even the pot is quiet.
Zero. The vase stays a myth.
Lot pulled. Go hit the casino.

ru: Менты! Тут ствол и плохие манеры!
en: Cops! Gun and bad manners here!
Hello, station? Flipper with a surprise.
Police! The pot is not an alibi!
Sold to the shiny bald one!
Goes to a pro! Trailer, cry!
As usual — to the old wolf!
Sold to a hunter! Pot just shrank!
Sold to the trailer with a leaky pot!
Goes to the newbies! Enjoy the junk!
Sold! Needle in a haystack time!

ru: Этим! Скотч в подарок не даём!

en: Sold to the party! Don't drop the hamster!

ru: Не надо! Котёл и так нервный!

en: I warned you! Now the station!
Cry into the paddle. I like it.
Taking it all! Pot's on fire!
Whatever! The vase is worth it!
Bluff. Like a hamster in a box.
Hey! Don't poke with the paddle!
The vase is a myth. Like a fair dealer.
Not today. My pot stays intact.
Pass. Hunt the vase without me.
Too rich for a box of socks.
Not giving it up that cheap!
A hundred more! For the vibe!
I pass. You're the hero. Pay.
Don't lift — you'll tear your back.
Bid. Then cry into the tape.

column4: Watch a pro walk off with the vase.

ru: Два раза. Я запомнил твоё лицо.
Пять. Всё. Я больше не Лысый — я Мститель.
en: Five. That's it. I'm not Baldy anymore — I'm the Avenger.

ru: Сколько можно?! У меня же кредит на весло!
en: How many times?! I've got a loan on this paddle!

ru: Второй раз. Лысина блестит — ты нет.
en: Second time. My head shines — you don't.

ru: Я уже сбился со счёта. Ты — тоже, судя по котлу.
en: Lost count already. So did you, judging by your pot.
